title: Selective separation of critical metals from lithium-ion batteries in a two-phase leaching system based on a hydrophobic deep eutectic solvent and H2O2 solution
content:
RSC Sustainability, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SU00657K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kevin Septioga, Adroit T. N. Fajar, Rie Wakabayashi, Masahiro Goto
A two-phase system using a hydrophobic deep eutectic solvent (2 mol of 4,4,4-trifluoro-1-(2-thienyl)-1,3-butanedione: 1 mol tri-n-octylphosphine oxide) and H2O2 enabled selective recovery of Li, Co, Ni, and Mn from spent lithium-ion batteries.
